remarks: Water views across Veteran's Park in East Norwalk from this totally renovated, over-sized one bedroom second floor apartment. Large living room room w 9 foot ceilings and lots of natural light. Beautiful, brand new kitchen w great counter space, lots of cabinets, plus new washer and dryer. Large bedroom with built-in closet system and a separate office. Totally remolded bathroom with deluxe shower. Second floor deck overlooking the park and Norwalk harbor is shared with other tenants. Central air, natural gas heat. Parking for one car in driveway off Betts Pl. Tenant pays heat, electricity, credit check, liability insurance, cable, maintenance repairs. Great location within walking distance to East and South Norwalk train stations. 1 hour to NYC. Minutes walk to Sono restaurants and attractions. Credit check, no smoking, no pets. Available immediately.
